text_en: Your body will now prolong the effects of <color=OBJ>vials</color> on you, meaning you can take advantage of their benefits for longer.
I know the idea excites you, but just you hold on a second, soldier.
Do you think you'd be able to bring me another <color=OBJ>twenty Bygul</color>?
Don't look at me like that. This benefits you more than it does me, after all.
You know where to find me. I'll be waiting patiently.
